retrieved_via: web text rendering; manually transcribed selected zero-based source rows; generated normalized facts
immutable_content_note: Immutable raw content was unavailable; retrieved master rows are not asserted byte-identical to the history-head revision.
limitations: Dedicated mana-weapon catalog membership retains MAGICAL; fixed Card.attack/boost/mp remain zero and do not replace the dynamic effect.
A standalone base uses twice the current source MP as base damage, then consumes all current MP before response.
Zero MP is allowed and produces zero base damage; ordinary supported boosts can still add positive damage.
The source attack validator does not permit MAGICAL as an added attack component, so ID57 is a base weapon only.
Existing ordinary INCREASE_ATK and ADD_ATTRIBUTE components remain supported; additional MAGIC197/217, MAGIC_FREE, DOUBLE_ATK and WIDE_ATK remain excluded.
Later inclusion of additional magic would require retaining the source recalculation/order behavior rather than assuming this base-only formula universally.
It remains WEAPON-origin for reflection, bounce and block applicability; the name MAGICAL does not make it MAGIC-origin.
The empty source attribute is neutral and participates in ordinary attribute composition.
The record has no static MP recovery/cost field, minimum-MP requirement, percentage, disease, harm or miracle retention.
Card.discardable follows the existing weapon profile rule and is false.
The supported damage bound is 99*2 + 15*15 = 423, within the existing 480 base bound used for counter overflow limits.
Assistant-generated MAGICAL effects and exact historical XML traces are outside this restricted artifact pool.
Historical IDs and technical labels are not verified current official IDs or names.
Old acquisition weights are not verified official probabilities; upstream reports distribution uncertainty.
All seventeen earlier catalogs, fingerprints and miracle indices remain unchanged.
